constructor.details: Retains the existing deployment/ownership model; the deployer owns it.

depositBalanceToEntryPoint(uint256).details: Judge note: on Arc, native USDC has 18 decimals while its ERC-20 view      has 6. Sub-1e12-wei remainders are invisible to withdrawFees. Both views      represent one asset, not independent balances: this owner-only path      can use any existing native balance, including those remainders.      Nonpayable by design: amount comes from this contract, not msg.value.      Insufficient balance or a failed EntryPoint call reverts without a      Deposited event; a no-code EntryPoint cannot silently swallow funds.

depositToEntryPoint().details: The paymaster must have a positive deposit at the EntryPoint      so the EntryPoint can debit gas costs from it. Owner-only to      preserve the existing deposit-management policy. Devnet staking      and unstake-delay requirements depend on the actual EntryPoint.

postOp(uint8,bytes,uint256,uint256).details: This hook only emits sponsorship metadata; it never pulls USDC.      Judge note: sponsorship is FREE. The protocol account executes the      release and the vault pays its recorded whitehat without a fee.      A future relay calling AS the paymaster may use the vault's separate      paymaster-caller fee branch; this hook does not implement that relay.      Retains the existing mode handling: opReverted returns early;      other modes emit the event using the EntryPoint-supplied context.

params.actualGasCost: The actual gas cost in ETH (wei).
params.actualUserOpFeePerGas: The actual fee per gas unit.
params.mode: Whether the op succeeded or reverted.

setMaxSponsoredCost(uint256).details: Judge note: owner-only policy tuning; zero permits only zero-maxCost      requests. Emit old/new values to make changes visible to observers.      This does not implement an aggregate or per-sender spending budget.

setSponsoredProtocol(address,bool).details: Judge note: only the owner can admit protocols; fresh tiny bounties      cannot bypass this default-deny gate. Revocation blocks future      validation without resetting any bounty's consumed attempts.      Production would still add a sponsor signature and spending budgets.

validatePaymasterUserOp((address,uint256.details: Sponsorship allowlist for judges, in order:      1. The outer selector must be execute(address,uint256,bytes).      2. Its destination must be the immutable BountyVault address and its         native value must be zero because releaseBounty is nonpayable.      3. Its inner selector must be releaseBounty(uint256,uint256,address).      4. Its encoded fee must be zero: sponsorship is explicitly FREE.      5. The sender must be an owner-approved protocol, checked before         any vault read or attempt consumption in the private helper.      6. The sender must own the real open bounty and name its whitehat.      7. maxCost must not exceed the owner-configured per-operation cap.      8. The bounty must have an unused attempt; validation consumes it.      Judge note: owner approval removes the permissionless bounty-rotation      drain; creating unlimited tiny bounties cannot admit an unapproved      sender. Rejected senders cause no state writes and no vault calls.      The view call ties sponsorship to a real open bounty owned by the      sender rather than merely recognizing a selector. Open is uint8(1);      unknown, disputed, or terminal deals are not eligible. Malformed ABI      input reverts; alternate targets/selectors are rejected.      Eligibility is not a guarantee execution will succeed: the vault      repeats its execution-time checks. Judge note: nonzero outer native      value is rejected before sponsorship of a guaranteed nonpayable revert.      The account/EntryPoint must provide signature authentication.      PRODUCTION REQUIREMENTS: add a sponsor signature, per-sender budgets,      and EntryPoint stake/storage-access-rule compliance for vault reads.      Judge note: at most three admitted attempts bound cumulative loss per      bounty to attempts x maxSponsoredCost at a fixed cap, even when each      execution reverts; this is not a global or per-sender budget.      Frame-specific metadata, if required by a devnet, is not parsed here.

params.maxCost: Maximum native gas cost in wei, checked against the cap.
params.userOpHash: Hash of the user operation (unused by this policy).

returns.context: Encoded (dealId, whitehat) for the fee-free postOp event.
returns.validationData: Zero: valid with no time-range restriction.

withdrawFees().details: Judge note: retained for USDC paid through the vault's paymaster-caller      branch by a future relay, not fees from FREE sponsored protocol calls.      Check the token's boolean result: a failed transfer must not emit      a misleading withdrawal event. The owner-only policy is unchanged.

withdrawFromEntryPoint(address,uint256).details: Judge note: only the owner may select a nonzero recipient. The call      originates from this paymaster so EntryPoint debits its deposit, not      the owner's. A failed withdrawal reverts and emits no success event.

MAX_SPONSORED_ATTEMPTS_PER_BOUNTY().notice: Maximum admitted sponsorship attempts for any single bounty.

constructor.notice: Fix the trusted EntryPoint, sponsored vault, and fee token.

depositBalanceToEntryPoint(uint256).notice: Deposit existing native balance into this paymaster's EntryPoint deposit.

depositToEntryPoint().notice: Deposit ETH to the EntryPoint to cover gas for sponsored ops.

entryPoint().notice: The ERC-4337 / EIP-8141 EntryPoint contract.         On mainnet: 0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032         On alt mempool devnet: check EF docs for the address.

maxSponsoredCost().notice: Maximum sponsored cost per operation, in native-token wei.

owner().notice: Owner of the paymaster (can withdraw profits, manage deposits).

postOp(uint8,bytes,uint256,uint256).notice: Called by the EntryPoint AFTER the UserOperation executes.

setMaxSponsoredCost(uint256).notice: Set the maximum native-token wei cost of one sponsored operation.

setSponsoredProtocol(address,bool).notice: Approve or revoke a protocol smart account's gas sponsorship.

sponsoredAttempts(uint256).notice: Admitted sponsorship attempts, including reverted executions.

sponsoredProtocols(address).notice: Owner-approved protocol smart accounts eligible for sponsorship.

validatePaymasterUserOp((address,uint256.notice: Called by the EntryPoint during the VERIFICATION phase.

vault().notice: Address of the BountyVault whose releases are sponsored.

withdrawFees().notice: Withdraw accumulated USDC fees to the owner.

withdrawFromEntryPoint(address,uint256).notice: Recover native funds held in this paymaster's EntryPoint deposit.
